## Checklist

- [ ] The tests came first and failed before the change.
- [ ] CI is green on the pushed commit.
- [ ] The documentation that describes this change is updated in the same commit.
- [ ] No `any`, no lint waiver in a comment, no `void` call.
- [ ] Commit messages have a subject of at most 72 characters and a body of at most 8 lines.
- [ ] No tool attribution in any commit or in this description.
